items.label: Allow plain http addresses
items.description: Let webhooks be sent to http:// addresses, not only https://.
items.long_description: Off by default: a plain http address sends events unencrypted. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Hosts webhooks may reach on a private network
items.description: Names of hosts (like intranet.example.com or *.corp.example.com) that webhooks may send to even if they are on a private network.
items.long_description: A webhook address that resolves to a private, loopback or link-local address is refused unless its host is listed here. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Webhook attempts
items.description: How many times a delivery is tried before it is given up.
items.long_description: Waits between tries grow from one minute, doubling each time. A given-up delivery can be sent again by hand. Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Webhook first retry wait (seconds)
items.description: How long to wait before the second try of a delivery; each later wait doubles.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Keep webhook log (days)
items.description: How long the record of each delivery is kept; 0 keeps it forever.
items.long_description: Organizations can override the global default.

items.label: Switch a webhook off after (failed deliveries in a row)
items.description: A webhook whose deliveries keep giving up is switched off after this many in a row.
items.long_description: An administrator switches it on again after fixing the receiver. Organizations can override the global default.
